subject: Request: Accelerator allowance exception / short-term credit top-up
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@innovalabs.io>
To: priya_natarajan@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator allowance pressure — can we get a short top-up?

Hi Priya,

Quick context: our Innova cohort ramped faster than forecasted in week 2 — we chewed through the starter allowance (10k tokens) while validating multi-turn flows and vector search. Team is mid-demo with 2 pilot customers next week and we’re blocked from progressing due to rate limits and credit exhaustion.

Would Redwood consider a one-time accelerator allowance exception/top-up (~$15k worth of credits) to carry us through the pilot milestones? We can agree to milestone-based usage gating (e.g., reach pilot sign-off then pause) and provide a short mutual action plan if helpful.

Appreciate any fast help — the demos are on Tue/Wed next week.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Head of AI Platforms | Innova Labs
Attachments: pilot-demo-schedule.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodai.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@innovalabs.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator allowance pressure — can we get a short top-up?

Hi Sam — thanks for the note and congrats on the fast ramp.

We can do a conditional top-up but will need a couple of things to move quickly:
- a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that lists the pilot milestones and expected weekly token burn;
- confirmation of customer demos and expected date/time;
- agreement that the top-up is a one-time experimental allowance tied to the MAP.

I drafted a simple MAP template and attached it — fill in the milestones and return it. If it looks good, I’ll route to Programs for approval and to Finance for the top-up credit.

Proposed operational guardrails (to keep it conservative):
- $15k credit top-up max;
- automatic throttling at 90% of the top-up unless we hear otherwise;
- 14-day evaluation period followed by review.

I’ll loop Laura from Programs for sign-off on milestones.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_Innova_2027-04.pdf (attachment stub), playbook-accelerator-terms.docx (attachment stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodai.com>, Sam Patel <sam@innovalabs.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodai.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator allowance pressure — can we get a short top-up?

Thanks Priya and Sam — I reviewed the MAP draft (nice and concise). Conditional approval from Programs: we will approve a $15,000 credit top-up for Innova Labs provided the following are met by Friday, Apr 23:
- completed MAP returned with milestone dates and demo attendees;
- at least one pilot customer demo scheduled and confirmed;
- acknowledgement from the Innova legal team of the accelerator playbook terms attached.

If the items above are in place by Apr 23, Marcus will authorize Finance to issue the credit and we’ll set the throttling/alert thresholds.

One note for Operations: please create a temporary quota bucket for Innova that expires automatically on May 2 unless extended.

Laura Bennett
Head of Accelerator Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam@innovalabs.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator allowance pressure — can we get a short top-up?

On Thu, Apr 15, 2027 at 08:21 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com> wrote:
> Thanks Priya and Sam — I reviewed the MAP draft (nice and concise). Conditional approval from Programs...

Hi Laura / Priya — thanks, we’ll return the MAP today with milestone dates and upload the legal acknowledgement. Demo for Pilot A is scheduled for Tue, Apr 20 at 11am PT (internal customer CRO & engineering). I’ve cc’d contracts@innovalabs.io to start any redline / DocuSign work.

We accept the throttling & 14-day evaluation. Can you confirm what the actual activation process looks like and whether we’ll get a billing credit note or a token bucket on our account?

Sam
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodai.com>

Cc: operations@redwoodai.com, finance@redwoodai.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator allowance pressure — can we get a short top-up?

Looping in Ops/Finance as requested. Next steps from our side (confirmed):
- Finance will provision a $15,000 credit (account-level invoice credit) tied to DEAL-4092;
- Ops will spin up a temporary quota/token bucket that maps to the credit and enforces a 90% throttle alert and auto-expiry on 2027-05-02;
- Contracts team: please route a quick DocuSign amendment referencing the accelerator playbook and the MAP; use the HubSpot deal id (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4092) in the amendment.

@Priya — please confirm when Innova returns the completed MAP and the legal ack; I’ll tell Finance to prepare the credit once we have the MAP.

Thanks,
